source_note: Archived inputs; not a new model run. Archive analysis metadata identifies source revision 8dc34517336c901a5ec70bc990c5d0d87995e842; current worktree HEAD is not claimed as generating these outputs.
slice: Exploratory Python x index 20, native scalar x center 2050 km; no x mean
grid: 40 x 80 x 64, dx=dy=100 km; W y mass centers at (j+0.5)dy; W native vertical faces excluding fixed bottom; height (PH+PHB)/9.81 for same run, time, x and face
view: Y 0–8000 km, Z 0–17 km (covers model top at this slice). Color limits symmetric and matched across all times and methods separately for raw and high-band; no clipping.
filter: DCT-II orthonormal along 80 y mass points, zero k=0..39 then inverse DCT-II; k>=40 gives nominal wavelength <=400 km for reflected 8000 km span; signed reconstructed physical field, not coefficient magnitude. Band includes shorter than 2dy in nominal continuous wavelength terminology only up to discrete Nyquist.
